facts.business: Radhe Developers (India) Limited is engaged in real estate development and construction activities.
key_risks: Delays in project approvals due to absence of a single-window clearance system
Rising cost of construction materials and labour
Availability and acquisition of suitable land parcels
Dependence on monsoon performance for sustaining rural demand
facts.related_party_note: There being no 'material' RPTs as defined under regulation 23 of Listing Regulations, 2015, there are no details to be disclosed in Form AOC-2. All RPTs during the year were conducted at arms' length and were in the ordinary course of business. Details are provided in the notes to the financial statements.
